### GT save function

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

### Hull

```{r hull, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

monthly_raw <- readr::read_csv("owen-hull.csv") |> 
  tidyr::separate(col = date, into = c("month_num", "day", "year"), sep = "/", remove = FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(month_num) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    ab = sum(ab),
    h = sum(h),
    double = sum(double),
    triple = sum(triple),
    hr = sum(hr),
    rbi = sum(rbi),
    bb = sum(bb),
    k = sum(k),
    hbp = sum(hbp),
    sf = sum(sf),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = dplyr::case_when(
      month_num == "2" ~ "February",
      month_num == "3" ~ "March",
      month_num == "4" ~ "April",
      month_num == "5" ~ "May",
      month_num == "6" ~ "June"
    )
  )


season_totals <- monthly_raw |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    month = "Total",
    ab = sum(ab),
    h = sum(h),
    double = sum(double),
    triple = sum(triple),
    hr = sum(hr),
    rbi = sum(rbi),
    bb = sum(bb),
    k = sum(k),
    hbp = sum(hbp),
    sf = sum(sf)
  )

unc_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a3.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=%2Fredesign%2Fassets%2Fimg%2Ficons%2FESPN%2Dicon%2Dbaseball.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>Owen Hull's Offense by Month</span>
       <span style='font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Hull leads Carolina in batting average, slugging percentage, and on-base percentage. <br>UNC plays Oklahoma in the 2026 National Championship series starting Saturday, June 20.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png'
       style='height: 60px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)

monthly_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(monthly_raw, season_totals) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = c("June", "May", "April", "March", "February", "Total")),
    singles = h - (double + triple + hr),
    tb = singles + (double * 2) + (triple * 3) + (hr * 4),
    
    # Calculate percentages
    avg = h / ab,
    obp = (h + bb + hbp) / (ab + bb + hbp + sf),
    slugging = tb / ab,
    ops = obp + slugging
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(month) |> 
  dplyr::select(month, avg, ab, h, double, triple, hr, rbi, bb, k, obp, slugging, ops)


fn_baseball_fmt <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_replace(sprintf("%.3f", x), "^0", "")
}

gt_table <- monthly_stats |> 
  gt::gt() |> 
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |> 
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::html(unc_header)
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    month = "Month", avg = "AVG", ab = "AB", h = "H", double = "2B",
    triple = "3B", hr = "HR", rbi = "RBI", bb = "BB", k = "K",
    obp = "OBP", slugging = "SLG", ops = "OPS"
  ) |> 
  gt::fmt(
    columns = c(avg, obp, slugging, ops),
    fns = fn_baseball_fmt
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(avg, ab, h, double, triple, hr, rbi, bb, k, obp, slugging, ops)
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = month
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#f2f2f2"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(obp, slugging, ops))
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(font = "RobotoCondensed-Bold", weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = ops)
  ) |> 

  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      gt::cell_borders(sides = "top", color = "black", weight = gt::px(2))
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(rows = month == "Total")
  ) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(avg),
    rows = month != "Total", 
    direction = c("column"),
    method = c("numeric"),
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(.250, .630),
    alpha = 0.6,
  ) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(obp),
    rows = month != "Total", 
    direction = c("column"),
    method = c("numeric"),
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(.450, .660),
    alpha = 0.6,
  ) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(slugging),
    rows = month != "Total", 
    direction = c("column"),
    method = c("numeric"),
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(.300, 1.050),
    alpha = 0.6,
  ) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(ops),
    rows = month != "Total", 
    direction = c("column"),
    method = c("numeric"),
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(.800, 1.7),
    alpha = 0.6,
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(
    table.background.color = "floralwhite",
    heading.title.font.size = 18,
    heading.subtitle.font.size = 11,
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.color = "transparent"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::md("Table by Chris at Bless your chart | data via goheels.com")
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels(),
      gt::cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(675)) |> 
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#56a0d3", "#89BDE0", "#BBD9ED"))


gt_save_crop(
  gt_table,
  file = "hull_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "floralwhite"
) 

gt_table

```

### UNC pitching log

```{r pitching-log, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

nc <- readr::read_csv("ncwide.csv") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(order) 


unc_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a3.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=%2Fredesign%2Fassets%2Fimg%2Ficons%2FESPN%2Dicon%2Dbaseball.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>Carolina's 2026 NCAA Tournament Pitching Log</span>
       <span style='font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Carolina will play Oklahoma in the 2026 National Championship Series starting Saturday, June 20.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png'
       style='height: 60px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)

nc |> 
  cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(opp, opp, logo_height = 15) |>
  dplyr::select(
    pitcher,
    game_date,
    opp,
    metadata,
    result,
    inn_1,
    inn_2,
    inn_3,
    inn_4,
    inn_5,
    inn_6,
    inn_7,
    inn_8,
    inn_9,
    bf,
    innings,
    pitch_count,
    hits, 
    bb,
    k,
    er,
    runs
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(metadata, opp, game_date) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(result = tidyr::replace_na(result, "-")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = starts_with("inn_"), # <-- Changed to starts_with
      .fns = \(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | stringr::str_trim(x) == "", 0, 1)
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::gt(row_group.sep = " | ") |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::cols_align(opp, align = "left") |>
  gt::text_transform(
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(),
    fn = function(x) {
      lapply(x, gt::md)
    }
  ) |> 
  gt::sub_missing(rows = gt::everything(), missing_text = " ") |> 
  gtUtils::gt_indicator_boxes(
    key_columns = c("pitcher", "result", 
                    "innings", "k", "bb", "pitch_count", "bf", "er", "runs", "hits"),
    color_yes = "#56a0d3",
    color_na = "#e1e1e1"
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = "pitcher",
    col2 = "result",
    palette = c("black", "#333333"),
    small_cap = FALSE
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = "k",
    col2 = "bb",
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(
    col1 = "er",
    col2 = "runs",
    palette = c("black", "#333333")
  ) |> 
  gtUtils::gt_column_subheaders(
    opp = list(heading = "Opponent", subtitle = "Score | Game Duration"),
    # result = list(heading = "Result", subtitle = "W/L/-"),
    innings = list(heading = "Innings", subtitle = "Pitched"),
    pitch_count = list(heading = "Pitch", subtitle = "Count"),
    bf = list(heading = "Batters", subtitle = "Faced"),
    hits = list(heading = "Hits", subtitle = "Allowed"),
    k = list(heading = "Strikeouts", subtitle = "Walks"),
    er = list(heading = "Runs", subtitle = "Earned"),
    heading_color = "black",
    subtitle_color = "gray"
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    pitcher = ""
  ) |> 
  gt::cols_label(!!!rlang::set_names(as.character(1:9), paste0("inn_", 1:9))) |> 
  #gt::data_color(
  #  columns = gt::starts_with("inn_"),
  #  palette = c("#BBD9ED", "#89BDE0", "#56a0d3"),
  #  domain = c(1, 7),
  #  na_color = "#ffffff"
  # ) |> 
  gt::tab_spanner(
    columns = gt::starts_with("inn_"), 
    label = gt::html("<span style='font-family: \"Chivo\", sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none;'>Innings</span><br>Batters Faced<span style='font-family: \"Chivo\", sans-serif; font-weight: normal; font-size: 11px; color: gray; text-decoation: none;'></span>")
  ) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_grid(color = "black",
                          weight = 0.5,
                          include_labels = FALSE) |> 
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(unc_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::html(
      "<hr>UNC is making its 13th trip to the Men's College World Series and the second in the last three seasons.<br>
      <hr><b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart | data via goheels.com</b>"
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(775)) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(
        v_align = "middle"
      )
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = gt::starts_with("inn_"))
  ) |> 
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(columns = gt::everything(),
                              rows = c(14), fill = "#fffec8") |>
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(columns = "k",
                              rows = c(13), fill = "#fffec8") |>
  #gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(columns = c("bf", "innings", "pitch_count"),
  #                            rows = c(9), fill = "#fffec8") |>
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(columns = "pitcher",
                              rows = c(4, 6, 7, 9, 11, 14, 17, 19, 22, 23, 27), fill = "#BBD9ED") |>
  gtExtras::gt_highlight_rows(columns = "pitcher",
                              rows = c(17), fill = "lightpink") |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#56a0d3", "#89BDE0", "#BBD9ED")) -> ncp

gt_save_crop(
  ncp,
  file = "ncp_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
)

ncp
```
